Both reviewed road-car sources describe a five-speed manual. A dogleg five-speed manual is an H-pattern lever-operated gearbox. The H-pattern manual arrangement requires a clutch to pull away from rest under the project's derivation rules. Manual blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Automatic blip is a downshift action and is not applicable to the upshift field. Throttle lift is modeled only for upshifts in this schema. Automatic cut is modeled only for upshifts in this schema.
